FCI327 heading verifies both names and clearly distinguishes the Giant Schnauzer ancestor. Russian Bear Schnauzer gets no display owner on either distinct identity. BRT is an abbreviation; raw search retained.

FCI170 identifies the Castro Laboreiro dog. Portuguese Watchdog is generic and collides with Rafeiro; no display owner. Portuguese Cattle Dog is a loose historical label; retained search-only pending precise contextual support.
FCI288 distinguishes Hairless and Powder Puff. Puff cannot stand for the entire breed; Curtis remains unverified and Crested is abbreviated. Suppress optional display, preserving all raw aliases.

FCI181 heading verifies Riesenschnauzer. Russian Bear Schnauzer collides with Black Russian Terrier and is not established by this standard as exact alias; no display owner. Munich names remain searchable, not declared false.

FCI235 heading verifies Deutsche Dogge. Apollo of Dogs and Gentle Giant are epithets; Gentle Giant also collides with Leonberger. German Mastiff retained in search pending independent historical-name evidence.

FCI241 heading verifies local and full English names. Hungarian houn is truncated. Full corrected English name avoids cataloguing a fragment as a synonym.
FCI331 heading verifies local and English names. Karabash is shared with separate Anatolian/Karabash identities and has no exclusive display owner. Preserve all source aliases in search.

Retained Northern Lights operator history describes Labrador sled dogs, not Labrador Retriever×Husky crosses. Huskador/Huskydor cannot establish that exact landrace identity; suppress display pending evidence, preserving search and stable ID.
Gentle Giant/Gentle Lion are character epithets, not precise identification; Gentle Giant collides with Great Dane. Leo is an abbreviation. No exclusive display owner; raw search retained.

International Windsprite Club ballot explicitly passed renaming Longhaired Whippet to Windsprite effective2017-01-01. Add modern name to display/search; keep stable ID and original name pending separate identity policy.

FCI363 title verifies Czech spelling and Prague Ratter translation. Prazsky Krysavik is erroneous. Use verified local name, retaining French/Spanish/raw variants in search without declaring them false.

Reject suspected conflation as unproven: Hungarian Puli Club history explicitly documents historical Hungarian Water Dog terminology attributed to Hoffmann and water-walking Puli usage. Retain the historical synonym with scoped evidence; this does not classify modern Puli as a water-dog family.

FCI96 heading gives Rafeiro of Alentejo. Mutt of Alentejo is a misleading literal gloss; Portuguese Watchdog generic/colliding; Portuguese Mastiff not unique. Keep raw search, display verified translation.
North Indian is a generic regional phrase rather than precise breed name. N exact-identity work does not make this bare phrase an identifying alias. Display omitted, search preserved.

UKC standard defines Rat Terrier and size divisions; Rat is generic, Decker Giant denotes a narrower type, Rattie is a nickname. American Rat Terrier remains source/search data but optional display narrowed pending exact-name support. No ID merge.

FCI352 heading verifies Russkiy Toy and history documents Russian toy-terrier development. Russian Terrier is ambiguous; Moscow names specifically concern historical long-haired type. Retain raw aliases without presenting every subtype as whole breed.
FCI340 heading supplies exact Portuguese name. Remove and other versions and translations, which is clearly a prose fragment. Keep raw variants and geographic translations searchable.

Tazi shares usage with other sighthounds and has no exclusive display owner. Persian Greyhound is a plausible established historical name but retained FCI269 does not verify it; optional display omitted pending a direct name source, raw search preserved. Tanji also unverified.

FCI319 explicitly says sometimes called Kochi-ken. Other VBO names are not verified for exact identity by this standard; retain search-only rather than transfer Mikawa identity or assert false histories.
FCI244 heading verifies Slovenský Kopov/Slovakian Hound. Black Forrest is misspelled; Black Forest name not supported by inspected exact source and could imply German origin. Keep search-only.

Nanny Dog implies unsupported child-safety reassurance, irrespective of nickname attestation; exclude displayed endorsement. Keep Staffy common contraction and raw search/history; behavior prose remains separately reviewed.

Toy Terrier is generic across distinct breeds; Amertoy/American Toy Terrier not independently established by inspected AKC standard/history. Omit optional display pending source, not assert these historical names false.
FCI68 heading verifies Tiroler Bracke. Tinolean is a misspelling; Tyroler orthography is retained search-only, not declared a separate identity.
FCI57 heading supplies precise local and English names. Hungarian Vizla and unspecifed are malformed; generic Hungarian Pointer also overlaps wire-haired type. Preserve raw search.
